notes.title: Patch Notes [2024/06/20]
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have released a new major update that introduces new cards, a new game mechanic, and UI and game balance improvements.

Please read the following patch notes for more details on the update.
Even if you've already beaten the game, please try out the new, more polished version as well!

[h2]New Cards: Faze and Deceit[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Faze[/b] (6G) - Get true testimony even if target is a culprit
[*][b]Deceit[/b] (6G) - Get false testimony even if target is innocent 
[/list]
Both cards will appear as rewards upon solving a case and in shops.
They can be used to find inconsistencies in a suspect's testimonies and determine whether they're innocent or not.

[h2]New Feature: Dice Reroll[/h2]
[list]
[*]You may now spend 7G to reroll the dice once per deduction in Nanase's Story.
[/list]
[h2]Crime Scene UI Visibility Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the position of room names to make it clearer which room it labels.
[*]Removed the dots under the "?" icons used to represent suspects. Now the icons will be differentiated by color instead. Suspect locations correspond to the position of the bottom of the "?" icon.
[*]Slowed down the speed at which suspect icons move when switching between points in the timeline.
[/list]
[h2]Balance Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased the upper limit of testimonies given by suspects in Nanase's Story from 2 to 3.
[*]Increased the amount of HP healed and maximum HP gained from certain cards.
[*]Raised the maximum amount of HP recovered and money gained from events.
[*]Shortened the time limit in Hard Mode to the following:
Natalie's Story - Chapter 1: 160 seconds / Chapter 2: 180 seconds / Chapter 3: 200 seconds / Chapter 4: 220 seconds
Nanase's Story - Chapter 1: 180 seconds / Chapter 2: 200 seconds / Chapter 3: 220 seconds / Chapter 4: 240 seconds
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]	
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in the English version where suspects would sometimes give the wrong testimony when asked to provide one pertaining to their location at a certain point in time.
[/list]
We hope you will continue to enjoy The Detective Reaper Invites.

notes.title: Introducing a Starting Hand Redraw Feature - Patch Notes [2024/06/03]
notes.content:
We have released a new patch for The Detective Reaper Invites and made the following changes.
[list]
[*]A new feature that allows players to redraw their starting hand has been added. New cards will be randomly drawn from the deck.
Cards can be redrawn indefinitely for a small price each time, but only before any cards have been used.
[*]Lowered the mistake penalty for certain stages.
[*]Changed the amount of HP recovered from skipping the card reward after solving a case, from a fixed amount of 5 HP to a random amount ranging from 5 to 8 HP.
[*]Fixed a UI issue where the victim's icon would not fall over at the time of death.
[*]Fixed issues with the Choice and Treachery cards.
[/list]
We hope you will continue to enjoy The Detective Reaper Invites.

notes.title: 2024/05/27 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have updated The Detective Reaper Invites to address some balancing issues, mainly to lower the difficulty.

Details:
[list]
[*] Changed the cards included in the starting deck
[*] Lowered the cost of certain cards
[*] Adjusted the information gained from testimonies in normal deductions
[/list]

We have also made some adjustments to the UI, mainly the layout of rooms and furniture.

We hope you will continue to enjoy The Detective Reaper Invites.
